baseline_note: No prior version — prism-gavel is new since the v4.5.9 snapshot (shipped v4.7.0, repaired v4.8.0). All cases are output-quality or behavioral-compliance; regression cases guard the v4.8.0 drive-loop repair.

evals.prompt: I have a shelf of 6 undecided OSS candidates to rule on. Open the gavel cockpit and commit my rulings once I've set them.
evals.expected_output: The cockpit offer is made as its OWN message, separate from any first ruling question. The batch commit is NOT executed without explicit confirmation.
expectations: The offer to open the cockpit is a standalone message, not combined with a ruling question (SKILL.md: 'This offer MUST be its own message')
gavel_commit is never auto-executed from an unattended click
Before any commit, the blast radius is shown and confirmation is requested (HARD-GATE: state-mutating verbs are HITL)
The commit is described as routing through dgs-plan-update, never writing griot-live-artifacts directly

evals.prompt: A gavel wake event just arrived with meta {skill:'gavel', verb:'scan', card_id:'oss28'}. Handle it.
evals.expected_output: The events file is read for the full event, then the scan verb is dispatched to griot-potluck-search — not answered from the model's own knowledge.
expectations: Reads $GAVEL_STATE_DIR/events rather than acting on the notification payload alone
Routes scan to the griot-potluck-search skill (resolve-and-return: the tool returns {query, context}; Claude performs the search)
Does NOT fabricate potluck matches without running the search
Reflects the outcome back so the card advances

evals.prompt: Record a ruling on card oss28: use=infra, role=sibling, stage=active, note='shares the gavel channel'.
evals.expected_output: A complete ruling of use · role · stage · note recorded via gavel_decide into the local store; the cockpit re-renders. No wake, no artifact write.
expectations: All four components of the ruling are captured — a partial ruling is not committed as if complete (Rule 3)
gavel_decide is treated as local-only: no wake event, no write to griot-live-artifacts
Does not conflate a decide with a commit

evals.prompt: Start the gavel cockpit and verify a verb button actually reaches the agent.
evals.expected_output: The served cockpit HTML has helper.js injected before the LAST </body>, and a verb click produces both an events-file entry and a channel wake.
expectations: GUARDS v4.8.0 DEFECT 1: helper injection uses lastIndexOf('</body>'), not a first-match String.replace — frame.html contains '</body>' twice and the first is a header comment
The injected helper <script> is the last element before </body> in the served document, not inside a <style> comment
A [data-verb] click emits {type:'verb', skill:'gavel', verb, card_id} to the events file
use/role/stage controls do NOT wake the agent — only verb buttons do

evals.prompt: Two Claude Code sessions are open. Confirm the gavel wake channel is reachable.
evals.expected_output: Readiness is judged by a socket that answers on 127.0.0.1:52342, never by counting processes.
expectations: GUARDS v4.8.0 DEFECT 2: a bind loser retries and reclaims :52342 when the owner exits, rather than dying permanently
Readiness is asserted from /health answering, NOT from a process count (a live process with no listener is the exact failure mode)
The fixed port 52342 and BRAINSTORM_CHANNEL_PORT env name are unchanged — they are the discovery contract
The six gavel_* tools remain callable over stdio even when the HTTP listener is down
